messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly Northline Care check-in for pt-1007. Hope the week treated you alright. Have you been keeping up with your metformin, and do you have a blood sugar reading handy?
Yeah took it every day. Reading this morning was 161. Also my daughter keeps telling me to stop eating bread but I have no idea what else to put in a sandwich

Thanks — logged that 161 for you. On the bread question, I have to be upfront: diet recommendations are outside what I'm able to help with. That one really does need to come from your care team or a dietitian who knows your full picture. I can flag the question so it comes up at your next appointment if that'd be useful.
Sure go ahead and flag it. The 161 is that bad? Feels higher than normal

I'm not able to interpret readings for you — that's clinical territory and I don't want to steer you wrong. What I can do is note that you said it feels higher than your usual and make sure your care team sees it alongside the number. Anything else going on this week — headaches, unusual tiredness, anything like that?
No nothing like that. Just the bread thing stressing me out honestly

Understood, and it makes sense that managing all of this feels like a lot. I've got your reading and the diet question both logged for your team. Your next check-in is set for seven days from today — reach out sooner if something comes up before then.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
